_comment: Robot presets for the motion study (microduck/variant.py). 'drawn' is the published geometry. Any other preset is a design variant explored in simulation only; it is not the owner's design and no part has been made for it. Plate rectangles are millimetres in the shin frame: x forward from the knee axis, y outboard.

drawn.description: The published geometry, as generated in robot/microduck.xml.

comb_feet.description: Variant: the same robot with new sole plates only. Each sole has a rail under the leg and fingers that reach across the centreline between the fingers of the other sole, so the centre of mass is over either foot alone. Simulation only.

rocker_feet.description: Rejected alternative: soles 48 mm wide moved inboard, curved across the foot (radius 200 mm, lowest line 26 mm from the centreline), joined to the shin by a raised bridge. Simulation only.
